On Mon, Jun 13, 2022 at 6:18 PM Johnny Walsh <[contact omitted]> wrote:
[opaque block] Moving you to bcc, and adding Vera Zakem, our new Senior Advisor for Tech and Democracy and
overall lead on disinformation. Clare and Danny, it's great to e-meet you, and I'd love to chat. It's nothing urgent, but
if we can find a time this week, let's do it; after that I'll be out for two weeks, then back in town for a while. My
colleague Sofie (also cc'd) can help us find a time. Thank you!
Johnny
On Mon, Jun 13, 2022 at 7:20 AM Clare Melford < [opaque block] disinformationindex.org> wrote:
[opaque block] and good to meet you Johnny
Many thanks for making the connection.
We'd be delighted to set up a call and share more of our work and our perspective on the business model of
disinformation. We'd be very interested to hear more about how USAID is thinking about the challenge also.
Perhaps we can arrange a videocall in the next few weeks?
1 am copying in Jo Jenks, another of our management team who will join the call from our side. And also Anna who
can offer a range of suggested times for a video call. As some of the GDI team are Europe based we will propose a
few options in US morning/European afternoon.
Looking forward to continuing the conversation
best wishes and thanks again for making the introduction
Clare
